title: Zurich Meetup
summary: Endla meetup in Zurich and gliding above the Alps...
body_markdown:
As remote company we get to meetup all over the world. Recently Riley visited Gerhard in Zurich.


Gerhard joined the team as the VP Engineering. He brought a wealth of experience in software development and mathematics. He’s also a world class glider pilot and took us for a flight over Zurich and the Alps. Here are some spectacular photos from the flight.


If you’re looking for a fast paced, challenging company checkout our[job board](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/endla/jobs) or send us your resume tocareers@endla.com .
